currentParagraphText: “But it will be your doing,” the Lodestar Matron said before sighing.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “But it will be your doing,” the Lodestar Matron said before sighing.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Your choice has been made, and it appears that peace is not an option you are willing to explore. Very well... let us adopt a more heavy-handed approach. Apprehend the Chosen.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Whatever happens is not on me,” Jake simply spoke, not going to get dragged into that logic. They had already established that the Holy Church was the one that had stolen the Truesoul in the first place. Jake wasn’t going to feel bad for whatever happened next.
